premium.ronin.name: Solar Ronin BOLT
premium.ronin.detail: A sun-forged BOLT design with a crested helmet, energy blade, animated stride and victory salute. Cosmetic only; BOLT is earned through gameplay.
premium.bastion.name: Iron Bastion TANK
premium.bastion.detail: A heavy-armour TANK design with a tower shield, reinforced shoulders, animated stride and victory salute. Unlock TANK through gameplay.
premium.medic.name: Star Medic PATCH
premium.medic.detail: A winged PATCH design with a luminous halo, medical insignia, animated stride and victory salute. Unlock PATCH through gameplay.
premium.prism.name: Prism Arsenal
premium.prism.detail: Mint and violet weapon trails, diamond impact sparks and prism projectile colours. Cosmetic only; attack damage and enemy warnings stay the same.
premium.collection.name: Signature Collection
premium.collection.detail: Solar Ronin BOLT, Iron Bastion TANK, Star Medic PATCH and Prism Arsenal. Four permanent cosmetic products; no robot unlocks or combat bonuses.
premium.bundle.overlap: You already own part of this collection. Buy only your missing products below; the bundle is unavailable to avoid duplicate purchases.
premium.preview.note: Preview only. No purchases, ownership changes, rewards or progress are saved.
premium.preview.drag: Drag to steer the preview squad. Try Dash to see the skin in motion.
